method.ambiguity: Require a plausible constant baseline and a local excess of 110–340 ms. Keep the winning sign only if competing near-cost explanations agree in sign and sufficiently overlap the same event range.
method.extent: The core range spans the local audio and picture event times with 80 ms outer padding. The supported range also extends toward the midpoint behind and ahead, by at most 180 ms from each outer event. Both ranges use shared matches and points. The wider span is a review range between timing anchors.
method.matching: Enumerate ordered one-to-one associations. Compare a constant audio-minus-picture offset against a single interval of changed offset, with distinct ordered support on both sides. Drop unmatched events with a fixed 70 ms-equivalent penalty each. Penalize an added timing change by 90 ms-equivalent.
method.points: Freeze the largest and second-largest ordinary-or-constant-shift score per calibration speaker before assessing held examples. Use the prior 0.40 temporal IoU and 80 ms signed-error rule. These are research points.
method.source: Use the committed B/P detections, decoded inner-lip release observations and native clock from the same 96 Lombard Grid views. Keep the prior development/held speakers and acoustic bias intact.
